author: TeIq
content: Delivered: second_opinion_threads + second_opinion_messages migration with GENERATED ALWAYS body_tsv tsvector + GIN index + BEFORE UPDATE trigger raising P0001. SecondOpinionRepo trait + PgImpl. 4 API routes: POST /api/incidents/:id/second-opinion (open thread), POST /api/threads/:id/messages (append; replaces_message_id for edits-via-new-row), GET /api/threads/:id, GET /api/threads/search?q= (plainto_tsquery + ts_rank_cd). 4-scenario integration test: thread round-trip, FTS rank, SQL injection safety, append-only invariant proven via raw UPDATE rejection. .sqlx cache grew from 69 to 74 entries.
